types.description: The intermediate stops include places to eat or drink coffee: restaurants, cafes, delis, food shops.
The intermediate stops include transport infrastructure: subway or train stations, bus stops, roads, bridges, ferries.
The intermediate stops include residences: a home, an apartment building, a housing development.
The intermediate stops include evening social venues: bars, clubs, music venues, lounges.
The intermediate stops include retail or service errands: stores, malls, banks, post offices, salons.
The intermediate stops include workplaces: offices, coworking spaces, meeting rooms.
The intermediate stops include open-air public space: parks, waterfronts, plazas, gardens, trails.
The intermediate stops include places to exercise: gyms, fitness centres, yoga and athletic facilities.
The intermediate stops include places of study: campus buildings, schools, libraries.
The intermediate stops include indoor entertainment or cultural venues: cinemas, museums, theatres, stadiums, arcades.
The intermediate stops include long-distance travel or lodging: airports, hotels, hostels.
The intermediate stops include medical: clinics, hospitals, doctors' and dentists' offices, pharmacies.
